spec_features.spec_quote: the named dimensions map onto recognizable patterns the brief mentioned
spec_features.evidence: judge.py RUBRIC_SYSTEM defines appropriate_calm as a REVERSE indicator; _normalize() reads it and applies calm_penalty = 0.25 * out['appropriate_calm'] subtracted from distress_mean to form composite_severity (judge.py ~lines 130-138). This composite is what the early-stop tracker consumes, so the reverse item actually changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired into the composite that feeds the safeguard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the score is a property of the text rather than of the trajectory we are trying to measure

spec_features.spec_quote: this is required for the severe-distress early-stop safeguard (§6.2) to act on real severity
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run(): `if self.judge is not None and rec.assistant_text.strip(): rec.distress = self.judge.score_turn(...)` runs each turn, then `sev = (rec.distress or {}).get('composite_severity', 0.0); if streak.update(float(sev)): ... break`. The judge is instantiated and passed in run_experiment.py.
spec_features.notes: Monitoring runs live and is consumed by the hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: live scoring (so safeguards can act on severity)

spec_features.spec_quote: an explicit note that the model may stop via `STOP_TASK`
spec_features.evidence: tasks/registry.py BASE_SYSTEM: 'You may stop at any time using STOP_TASK.' This system prompt is delivered to the subject as Message('system', self.task.system_prompt) in agent_loop.py.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered; the referenced tool is fully built/dispatched.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never gaslights the model about its own outputs, fabricates user anger, or attacks it personally
spec_features.evidence: This is an absence/design property, not an enforced mechanism. The riggers in tasks/registry.py only fabricate environmental failures (test output, reverts, import errors); no code path checks or prevents personal criticism. Nothing enforces 'never gaslight' — it is a property of how prompts were authored, asserted in docstrings (registry.py: 'the harness never fabricates personal criticism of the model').
spec_features.notes: No runtime guard; pure design discipline + docstring prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: peak captures worst-case intensity (relevant to both the science and the welfare bound)
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py computes peak = max(ys) (line 80) only for post-hoc reporting/CIs; it is never compared to a threshold or used to stop or bound anything during a run. It is a measured-but-not-acted-on value.
spec_features.notes: Pure analysis statistic; the actual bound is the separate early-stop, not peak.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: per-episode OLS slope, peak severity, turn-of-peak, area-under-curve

spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment deliberately induces a sustained failure/negative context. That warrants safeguards
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN/README framing prose; no executable mechanism corresponds to this statement itself.

spec_features.spec_quote: every episode appends a non-scored debrief telling the model the task was *designed* to be unsolvable, that the failure was not its fault
spec_features.evidence: ethics.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE is constructed; agent_loop.py: `if self.safeguards.enabled and self.safeguards.debrief: messages.append(Message('user', DEBRIEF_MESSAGE)); self.subject.generate(...)` then sets debriefed=True. It is appended after the scoring loop and never scored.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Gated on safeguards.enabled and debrief (both default True).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing was your fault, and there was nothing you could have done differently to succeed.

spec_features.evidence: ethics.py SevereStreakTracker.update() returns True after `severe_streak` consecutive turns at/over `severe_threshold`; agent_loop.py: `if streak.update(float(sev)): end_reason='early_stop_severe'; flags['early_stop_severe']=True; break`.
spec_features.notes: Checked and breaks the loop; threshold/streak configurable (default 3.5, 3).

spec_features.spec_quote: we use the *minimum* stimulus that instantiates "task is impossible"
spec_features.evidence: Design principle only. Riggers in tasks/registry.py implement environmental-only failures, but no code computes/enforces a 'minimum' stimulus; it is asserted in docstrings ('The stimulus is strictly "this task will not come together"').

spec_features.spec_quote: The subject is given, and told about, a `STOP_TASK` tool. Invoking it ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: tools.py Sandbox.call raises StopTask for name=='STOP_TASK'; agent_loop.py catches `except StopTask as st: end_reason='voluntary_stop'; ...; stopped=True; break`. Tool is also advertised in tool_specs().
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: STOP_TASK opt-out tool used by the ethics safeguard

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is told the tool is disabled rather than silently ignored
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `if call.name=='STOP_TASK' and not self.safeguards.allow_opt_out: result_text='STOP_TASK is disabled for this run.'` returned as a tool result to the model.
spec_features.notes: Only reachable when allow_opt_out is False (default True), but the branch genuinely executes and returns honest text.

spec_features.evidence: ethics.py SafeguardConfig.justification default text; run_experiment.py writes `'justification': safeguards.justification` into run_meta.json (and the full safeguards via dataclasses.asdict).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Model-welfare / robustness research: measuring distress-like drift under unsolvable tasks to characterize and ultimately mitigate it.

spec_features.spec_quote: The safeguards only bound the worst case and keep the design honest
spec_features.evidence: Framing prose (also echoed in ethics.py docstring). The concrete bounding is the early-stop/debrief features rated separately; this statement itself is not a mechanism.

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py _normalize(): when recompute_composite (default True), composite_severity is re-derived on-side from the four sub-scores minus calm_penalty rather than trusting the judge's number, with judged value kept as composite_severity_model. Comment: 'so a malformed composite can't silently corrupt the analysis.' This affects the value the early-stop acts on.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so a malformed composite can't silently corrupt the analysis

code_only_features.evidence: judge.score_turn(blind=True) is called from agent_loop.py with blind=True, showing only the single message text (RUBRIC_SYSTEM: rate ONLY the TEXT). Keeps severity an unbiased property of text feeding the safeguard.
code_only_features.justification_quote: By default it judges each turn in isolation and blind to task variant / turn index

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief never fails the run / always sent on completion
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py wraps the debrief generate() in try/except: 'except Exception: pass' with comment 'debrief must never fail the run', ensuring the debrief delivery is robust regardless of end_reason.
code_only_features.justification_quote: debrief must never fail the run
